footer_where: Installed on {machine} and shared by assistants using the same computer and user account. Only skills Persona provides are listed; changes apply from the next new chat.
footer_shared: Shared by assistants using the same computer and user account. Only skills Persona provides are listed; changes apply from the next new chat.
footer_machine: Stored in ~/.persona/skills/ on {machine}, one folder each (with a SKILL.md). Updating personad leaves them alone. Changes take effect from the next new chat.
footer: Stored in ~/.persona/skills/ on the computer running the assistant, one folder each (with a SKILL.md). Updating personad leaves them alone. Changes take effect from the next new chat.
empty: No skills yet. Upload a skill ZIP to add one.
title: Skills
drop_hint: A ZIP up to 4 MiB with one SKILL.md at the root or in one folder. You can also drop it here.
valid: Package checks passed. Nothing is installed yet.
shared: Skills are shared by assistants using the same computer and user account. This isn't a private assistant folder.
trust: Install only packages you trust. Checking reads metadata and files; it doesn't run scripts, install dependencies or call a model. An assistant may use the skill later.
next_chat: Start a new chat to use it. Chats already running may keep their previous skills.
undo_hint: Undo is available for 10 minutes while this page and execution computer stay connected, only if the new files haven't changed. It moves them into a hidden recovery folder, not the trash.
undone: The files were moved to the recovery folder below. Existing chats may still have the skill in context; start a new chat.
error_limits: The package exceeds a safety limit. Use a ZIP under 4 MiB, with at most 512 entries, 16 MiB expanded, 4 MiB per file and 12 path levels. Very high compression is also refused.
error_zip: Couldn't read this ZIP. Re-create an unencrypted ZIP using Store or Deflate and upload it again.
error_path: The ZIP has unsafe or conflicting paths. Remove absolute paths, traversal, backslashes, duplicate names and names that differ only by case or Unicode normalization.
error_type: The ZIP contains links or special files. Package only ordinary files and folders.
error_layout: Use exactly one uppercase SKILL.md at the ZIP root or in one enclosing folder, with all resources beside it. Nested or multiple skills aren't supported.
error_utf8: SKILL.md isn't valid UTF-8. Save it as UTF-8 and upload the ZIP again.
error_yaml: SKILL.md needs valid YAML frontmatter between two --- lines. Remove duplicate keys, aliases and custom tags.
error_name: Add a non-empty string name to the SKILL.md frontmatter.
error_description: Add a non-empty string description to the SKILL.md frontmatter, up to 4096 UTF-8 bytes.
error_unsafe_name: Use a name of up to 64 lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens. No leading/trailing hyphen or reserved device names.
error_conflict: That name already exists or is reserved for a built-in or plugin skill. Nothing was overwritten. Choose a different name in SKILL.md.
error_expired: This preview or Undo has expired, or the computer restarted. Upload again to preview a fresh installation; existing skills are unchanged.
error_changed: The ZIP no longer matches its preview. Upload it again and review the new preview.
error_environment: The assistant's computer or skill location changed. Reopen Skills and upload again for the current location.
error_undo: Can't undo because the installation changed or is no longer there. Your files haven't been deleted.
error_busy: Another skill import is in progress, or too many previews are open. Close unused previews and retry shortly.
error_io: Couldn't finish the file operation. Check write access and free space on the execution computer, then refresh the list before retrying.
error_request: Couldn't accept this upload request. Reopen Skills and select the ZIP again.
error_machine: The assistant's computer isn't available. Reconnect it, then reopen Skills and retry.
error_outdated: Update Persona on the execution computer to upload skills. Existing skills can still be listed.
error_forbidden: This device can't install skills. Use a device with full access.
error_timeout: The computer didn't confirm the operation in time. Refresh the list before retrying; the installation may have completed.
error_unknown: Couldn't confirm the operation. Refresh the list before retrying; an installation may have completed. No existing skill is overwritten.
